statement.zh: 奥尔梅克为中美洲「母文化」单向输出源——交流方向仍争议，不作定论。
statement.en: That Olmec was a unidirectional Mesoamerican "mother culture" remains debated — not a fact verdict.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: mother vs sister culture / multi-directional interaction remains open.
